entries.en: I'm listening.
Yes? Talk to me.
Mhm... We will finish later.
Another time, then.
Anyway, as I was saying...
Where did we leave off...?
V. I'm waiting.
V? You want to say something?
Hmmph.
Watch out.
There is a reward for a certain person.
entries.ro: E o recompensă pentru o anumită persoană.

entries.en: Got a job for a certain person.
entries.ro: Am o treabă pentru o anumită persoană.

entries.en: When someone calls for help, you answer.
Someone is in trouble, needs help.
entries.ro: Cineva e în pericol, are nevoie de ajutor.

entries.en: I've got a job – a little sabotage.
entries.ro: Am o treabă – un pic de sabotaj.

entries.en: I've got a new mission. Quick and precise.
entries.ro: Am o misiune nouă. Rapidă și precisă.

entries.en: I need someone to carry something for my client.
entries.ro: Îmi trebuie cineva să ducă ceva pentru clientul meu.

entries.en: I have a transport job. Point A to point B.
entries.ro: Am o treabă de transport. De la A la B.

entries.en: Need you to get something back for a client of mine.
entries.ro: Ai de recuperat ceva pentru un client de-al meu.

entries.en: My client wants something that was taken from him.
entries.ro: Clientul meu vrea înapoi ceva ce i s-a luat.

entries.en: Have a job for you – theft. Doesn't have to be bold.
entries.ro: Am o treabă pentru tine – furt. Nu trebuie să fie ceva spectaculos.

entries.en: I need a certain thing. You need to take it from someone.
entries.ro: Îmi trebuie un anumit lucru. Trebuie să-l iei de la cineva.

entries.en: Leave the package in the locker.
You can leave the package for me in the locker.
